parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the external toggle part of the switch made of ABS plastic, designed for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to open or close the electrical circuit by toggling between ON and OFF positions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly within a small range to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another toggle part of the switch, also made of ABS plastic, functioning similarly to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as an independent control for a separate circuit or function, allowing dual control in one unit.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a similar toggling motion to engage or disengage its respective circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or base body of the switch, made of durable polycarbonate material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and insulation for the internal electrical components and switch mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the mounting and protective enclosure for the switch assembly.
